subject: Vendor onboarding — payment cadence & expedited remittance option
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@luminaanalytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding — Lumina Analytics / Redwood pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, Lumina Analytics is excited to start the integration work for the Redwood pilot. To get us into your PO flow we need the vendor onboarding packet and confirmation of payment cadence. Our standard is Net 30, but for cashflow planning we typically ask new customers if Net 15 or an early-pay arrangement is possible during the first 60 days.

I attached a completed W-9 for your records (W-9_Lumina.pdf). Could you confirm:
- Redwood's default net terms for new vendors?
- Any onboarding paperwork or vendor portal we should complete?
- How POs are issued (email vs portal) and expected invoice remittance window?

If useful, Lumina is open to an early-pay discount (we typically offer 1.5% for payment within 15 days) if Redwood can accelerate payment. Let me know who on your side should be on the vendor setup forms.

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Finance Ops Lead
Lumina Analytics

Attachments: W-9_Lumina.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@luminaanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Lumina Analytics / Redwood pilot

Hi Tara,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. Welcome — excited to get Lumina onboarded. Quick answers inline:
- Default terms: for new vendors our standard is Net 45 while we complete onboarding and supplier validations.
- Onboarding: we have a vendor form and an ACH/PO checklist that Finance needs; looping in Laura B. so she can share the form and next steps.
- POs: we issue PO numbers via our procurement portal and send the official PO to the vendor email on file; invoices should reference the PO number and be sent to invoices@redwoodinference.com.

Tara — Laura will advise on whether we can make an exception or pilot an accelerated remit. If finance is open, happy to coordinate the pilot terms that MarCom and Sales sign off on.

Alex
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Tara Singh <tara@luminaanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T12:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Lumina Analytics / Redwood pilot

Hi Tara / Alex,

Thanks for the note. Laura from Finance here. A couple of items we need before issuing a PO and switching Lumina to live billing:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I will attach our Excel form in a separate message)
- W-9 (received; thanks)
- ACH remittance details or bank letter (for ACH setup)
- Point of contact for billing disputes and invoice delivery

On terms: our baseline for new suppliers is Net 45 while supplier validation completes. However, we’re running a small early-pay pilot for strategic partners. Typical structure we can consider: Net 30 with an early-pay discount (we have historically used 0.5% for payment within 10 days, but we can negotiate a higher rate for vendors that offer steeper discounts). To evaluate this we need: expected invoice cadence and an example invoice for sizing.

Tara — can you complete the attached Lumina_Vendor_Onboarding.xlsx and include your preferred ACH details? Once we have that, procurement will create the PO (Portal) and we’ll confirm the path for accelerated remit if approved.

I’ll mark this for expedited review pending the pilot approval from procurement and FP&A.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will send vendor form in next email)

From: Tara Singh <tara@luminaanalytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Lumina Analytics / Redwood pilot

Laura, Alex — thanks. I attached the completed vendor onboarding spreadsheet (Lumina_Vendor_Onboarding.xlsx) and included ACH details and our billing POC (procurement@luminaanalytics.com).

Regarding terms: Lumina can offer a 1.5% early-pay discount for invoices paid within 15 days. If Redwood is able to commit to an accelerated remit for the first 60 days while the integration goes live, that would materially help our operations. Our invoice cadence will be monthly with the first invoice issued at the completion of SOW milestones (we expect the first invoice in early December).

Please confirm receipt of the onboarding file and whether the 1.5% for 15-day payment window could be accommodated or if we should propose a fall-back (e.g., Net 30 with a smaller discount).

Thanks,
Tara

Attachments: Lumina_Vendor_Onboarding.xlsx (Excel, 92KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tara Singh <tara@luminaanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence & expedited remittance option

Looping in from Sales — Lumina is an important partner for the pilot and faster payment will help accelerate delivery. To find middle ground, would the finance team consider: Net 30 standard with a 0.75% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 20 days? That reduces Redwood’s working capital impact relative to the 1.5%/15-day request but provides Lumina meaningful improvement. If finance signs off, I’ll update the SOW language to reflect the payment cliff and ensure PO notes reflect the early-pay eligibility criteria.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that would help resolve the exact timing.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Alex / Tara,

After reviewing the onboarding form and evaluating the pilot budget, Finance approves a pilot exception with the following conditions:
- Payment terms: Net 30.
- Early-pay: 0.75% discount if Redwood remits within 20 calendar days of invoice receipt.
- Pilot duration: first three invoices (approximately 90 days) and then revisited with procurement and FP&A.
- Execution: Lumina must sign the supplier addendum confirming the early-pay discount terms and provide ACH verification.

Tara — once you confirm and sign the DocuSign addendum (link below) we will create the PO in the procurement portal and route invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the PO number on the invoice. Payments under the early-pay pilot will be processed through our AP early-pay workflow.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-LUMINA

Please confirm acceptance and I’ll move forward with PO creation.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
